title: Portal
provenance: verified locally on Apple Silicon (M1 Pro), engine sikarugir-10.0_6, Highball 0.7.13, 2026-08-28
notes: Works at ~96 fps under DXVK with HDR off — and the Portal recipe turns it off for you (one button on the game's page in Highball). Same MoltenVK HDR bug and same fix as Portal 2: without mat_hdr_level 0 map loads die on this engine; with it the opening vault renders flawlessly with a clean device log. Apply the Portal fix after installing, keep the bottle on DXVK.

verified.fps: DISPUTED, do not quote. 96 was recorded on engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r1. Re-measured 2026-09-10 on r2, the shipping default, DXVK, 1728x1117, in the first chamber: 17.4 fps, with GPU time of 4.0 ms inside a 57 ms frame and the process at 124% CPU, so the GPU is idle and the cost is on the CPU. Portal 2 shows the same shape on the same engine while Five Nights at Freddy's, which is not a Source game, hits its recorded 60 fps in the same session. That points at something specific to Source rather than the machine, DXVK or MoltenVK. Confirming it needs engine r1 side by side, which is not installed here.
